title: Blue Origin reportedly raising $10B at $130B valuation
slides: Why is Blue Origin suddenly worth $130 billion?
The company is raising $10 billion in new funding.
But their rockets haven't flown profitably yet.
This could reshape who leads the next space race.
Watch for a competitor that now has real capital.
thread_text:
1. Why $130 billion?

Blue Origin is raising $10 billion—more than SpaceX's entire outside funding.

2. Rockets not profitable

Its New Glenn has never carried paying cargo. The valuation is pure future hope.

3. Bezos vs. Musk

This cash gives Blue Origin a multi-year runway to challenge SpaceX's Starlink and Starship.

4. A new space race

If Blue Origin wins NASA contracts, the private launch monopoly could crack open.

5. Your move

Track Blue Origin's next launch date. If it slips, watch the stock market reaction.

instagram.caption:
Blue Origin is raising $10 billion—more than SpaceX’s entire outside funding—at a $130 billion valuation.

It has zero profitable rocket flights. 🚀 Yet this cash pile gives Bezos a multi-year runway to challenge Musk for NASA contracts and Starlink.

If Blue Origin wins, the private launch monopoly cracks open. For anyone planning content around space or defense, this shifts the competitive landscape. 🔭
